Bank Full Model Test.question: ৩৪) Sharif ran a 2 mile race at an average speed of 8 miles per hour. If Arif ran the same race an average speed of 6 mile per hour, how many minutes longer than Sharif did Arif take to complete the race?

D = T × S

or, T = 1/4 hours
or T = 15 minutes

or, T = 15 minutes

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৩৬) A rectangular area of 16 meter by 12 meter, is surrounded by a road 3 meters wide. The area of the road is
Bank Full Model Test.exp:
Area of rectangle without road = 16 × 12 = 192
Area of rectangle with road = (16 + 2 × 3) × (12 + 2 × 3) = 396
Area of road = 396 - 192 = 204.

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৩৭) A train covers the distance x between two cities in y hours, arriving 2 hours late. What rate would permit the train to arrive on schedule?

or, S = X/(Y - 2)

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৩৮) Coffee A normally costs 100 taka per pound. It is mixed with coffee B, which normally costs 70 taka per pound, to form a mixture which costs 88 taka per pound. If there are 10 pounds of the mix, how many pounds of coffee A are used in the mix?
Bank Full Model Test.exp:

= 6

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৩৯) The area of a square plot is twice that of another square plot. If the diagonal of the bigger plot is x, what is the diagonal of the smaller plot?
Bank Full Model Test.exp:
Area of square = d2/2 (d for diagonal)
so, area of bigger square = x2/2
so area of smaller square = x2/4 (half of the bigger one)
one side of smaller square = √(x2/4)
= x/2
diagonal of smaller square d2 = (x/2)2 + (x/2)2
d = root 2 × x/2.

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৪০) The ratio of green marbles to red marbles in a box 3:5. If there are 24 marbles in the box, how many additional green marbles will be required to make the ratio of green marbles to red marbles 1:1?
Bank Full Model Test.exp:
Number of green ball = 24 × (3/8) = 9
Number of red ball= 24 × (5/8) = 15
since the required ratio is 1:1
so, additional green ball = (15 - 9) = 6

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৪১) Club A has 20 members and club B has 28. If a total of 42 people belong to the two clubs, how many people belong to both clubs?
Bank Full Model Test.exp:
Total Number = Club A + Club B - both club (van Diagram)
or, 42 = 20 + 28 - both
or, both = 6.

Bank Full Model Test.exp:

Commission for sales over 6000 = 4000 × 8% = 320
Total commission = 620.

(II) XY is odd
(III) (2X + Y) is even
Bank Full Model Test.exp:
odd + even = odd (4 + 5 = 9)
odd × even = even (4 × 5 = 20)
even × odd = even × even = even (2 × 5 + 4 = 14).

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৪৪) In a school with the same number of boys and girls, 1/8th of the girls and 5/6th of the boys are residing in the hostel. What percent of the students consists of boys who do not reside in the hostel?
Bank Full Model Test.exp:
Let,
Number of girls = boys = 24 (LCM of 8 and 6)
boys who do not reside in hostel = 24 - (5 × 24/6)
= 24 - 20
= 4
The students consist of boys who do not reside hostel = 4/(2 × 24)
= 1/12.

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৪৫) A football team has 40 games out of 60 played. It has 32 more games to play. How many of these must the team win to make it record 75% win for the seasons?
Bank Full Model Test.exp:
Total match = 60 + 32 = 92
75% of 92 = 69
